title: Go From Your Country
question: What is Abram asked to leave, and what is he promised instead?
blurb: One command, one promise, and a family that would bless every nation. Trace where the call leads.

nodes.content: What is Abram asked to leave, and what is he promised instead?

nodes.verseText: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.
I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.
The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and foretold the gospel to Abraham: “All nations will be blessed through you.”
